_meta.title: Reviewed natal lunar-node placements (North Node growth axis)
_meta.coverage: North Node x 12 signs + x 12 houses (each names its South Node counterpoint)
_meta.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
_meta.note: The nodes are a natal axis, not an aspect; South Node is always the opposite sign/house.

reviewed.title: North Node in Aries

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward standing on your own two feet: acting on your own wants, starting things without a committee
slots.release_pull: leaning on other people to decide, keeping the peace until you disappear
slots.lived_practice: Make one decision today without polling the group chat. Everyone will be fine

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: People who call you difficult are the ones who benefit from your lack of boundaries.

marie_advice.text: Hesitation becomes dangerous when it keeps you halfway inside a decision. You agree and then resist, leave and then return, speak and then take it back. Decide whether the move is yours. If it is, put your full weight behind it.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Taurus

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward steadiness and self-worth built slowly: knowing what's enough and letting life be simple
slots.release_pull: living in crisis and entanglement, measuring yourself through other people's intensity or resources
slots.lived_practice: Build one calm, self-sufficient thing and let it stay uncomplicated

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: Stop equating your worth with how much you own.

marie_advice.text: A promotion, a new apartment, a better title, or another impressive achievement can give you a good week. Then the excitement wears off and you are alone with the same dissatisfaction. If every milestone leaves you immediately searching for the next one, the problem may be somewhere your résumé cannot reach.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Gemini

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward curiosity and real listening: asking, gathering the local facts, staying a student
slots.release_pull: assuming you already know, preaching the big answer instead of hearing the actual question
slots.lived_practice: Ask one real question and let the answer change your mind

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: Trust that your voice is enough.

marie_advice.text: A strong opinion can harden quickly when it earns you attention. Soon you are defending something you barely believe because changing your mind would feel embarrassing. Keep enough distance from your own conclusions to notice when the facts have moved.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Cancer

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward feeling and tending: letting yourself need people and build a real emotional home
slots.release_pull: hiding inside control, status, and being the one who holds it all together
slots.lived_practice: Let one person see you before you've got it handled

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: Your needs are not too much.

marie_advice.text: A hard period can become so familiar that feeling better makes you uneasy. You may miss the music you listened to, the people who understood you then, or the excuse to expect very little from life. You can remember what those years taught you without continuing to live inside them.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Leo

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward heart and courage: creating from yourself and letting your individual warmth be seen
slots.release_pull: dissolving into the group, staying detached and above it to avoid standing out
slots.lived_practice: Make one thing that's unmistakably yours and put your name on it

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: You’re allowed to make things that don’t impress anyone but you.

marie_advice.text: When something succeeds, it is easy to remember every decision you made and forget the timing, help, luck, and access that carried it forward. Your effort mattered. So did the people who answered, opened a door, covered a shift, or gave you another chance. Knowing what helped you get here makes you a better leader once you arrive.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Virgo

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward useful order: discernment, craft, and showing up for the practical, humble work
slots.release_pull: escaping into fog, overwhelm, or martyrdom when the details ask something of you
slots.lived_practice: Do one small concrete task well instead of drifting past it

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: You don’t need to fix everything to deserve love.

marie_advice.text: A system can save time until maintaining it becomes another job. You color-code the calendar, rebuild the tracker, adjust the routine, and spend the afternoon preparing to begin. Use the structure that helps you move. Retire the parts that only make you feel temporarily in control.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Libra

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward partnership and fairness: considering the other person and building things with them
slots.release_pull: the me-first reflex, deciding alone, treating cooperation as weakness
slots.lived_practice: Ask someone what they need before you push your own plan

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: Stop fearing that boundaries mean you don't love enough.

marie_advice.text: Some rooms require so much social calculation that you forget what you actually think. You monitor the tone, flatter the right person, laugh at the right moment, and leave exhausted from saying almost nothing. Spend less time where honesty carries a penalty.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Scorpio

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward depth and honest intimacy: letting go, merging, facing what you'd rather not
slots.release_pull: clinging to comfort, possessions, and the familiar to avoid real transformation
slots.lived_practice: Let one thing end or one truth surface instead of gripping the safe version

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: Stop calling it stress when it's actually rage being suppressed.

marie_advice.text: You can feel when a room has turned strange. The conversation becomes mean, the questions get invasive, or your body starts looking for the nearest exit before your mind has explained why. You do not need to remain there long enough to collect evidence. Go.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Sagittarius

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward faith and meaning: trusting the bigger picture instead of drowning in every detail
slots.release_pull: scattering into information and second-guessing, collecting opinions to avoid a direction
slots.lived_practice: Commit to one belief you can act on and stop polling for more data

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: The ninth house is the house of freedom.

marie_advice.text: You can spend years waiting for the opportunity, person, or sudden break that will finally make movement possible. Meanwhile, the smaller exits keep appearing: one application, one phone call, one uncomfortable decision, one day of work. Take the next available step. A way out is often built while you are already moving.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Capricorn

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward maturity and self-authority: taking responsibility and building a structure that's yours
slots.release_pull: staying small and dependent, letting a mood or a caretaker run the decision
slots.lived_practice: Handle one thing you've been waiting for someone else to come rescue you from

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: Authority is the power to make choices about your own life. Status is the role that you play for other people.

marie_advice.text: Shortcuts become especially persuasive when the real work is repetitive. That is when people start buying tools they do not need, changing direction again, or talking about the work more than they do it. Return to the part that requires practice. Skill still grows the old-fashioned way.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Aquarius

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward contribution and the wider circle: your gift in service of something past your own spotlight
slots.release_pull: chasing approval and center stage, taking it personally when you're not the star
slots.lived_practice: Give to the group without needing the credit for it

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: Stop fearing that belonging means losing your individuality.

marie_advice.text: Every new idea arrives with a crowd insisting that it changes everything. A week later, the crowd has moved on and everyone pretends they were never impressed. You can watch the excitement without reorganizing your life around it. Let an idea survive its first round of applause before you follow it anywhere.
marie_advice.use: optional CONFIRMED expanded advice; serve verbatim

reviewed.title: North Node in Pisces

slots.growth_direction: Your growth is toward trust and surrender: compassion, imagination, and letting some things be uncertain
slots.release_pull: over-analysing, perfecting, and worrying every detail into the ground
slots.lived_practice: Let one imperfect thing be, and trust it will hold

reviewed.doctrine_source: Elizabeth Spring, North Node Astrology; Dane Rudhyar, The Lunar Nodes; Healing the Soul: Pluto, Uranus and the Lunar Nodes (doctrine only, voiced original)
reviewed.review_note: needs Marie/editorial final sign-off before serving

pull_quote.text: Some truths are felt in the body before the mind can understand them.

marie_advice.text: Some days you answer the messages, make the food, finish the shift, and feel almost nothing while doing it. That does not make the day meaningless. Keeping your life going during a low period is work, even when nobody sees anything dramatic happen.

slots.lived_practice: Start one thing for yourself before you check who it's for

marie_advice.text: Some relationships survive because one person keeps leaving the door cracked. You answer the late message, agree to one more conversation, and call it kindness even though every contact unsettles your life again. If leaving was necessary, finish leaving.
